title: The mid-command restore reaches the model but not the host's log
description:
containerLost (a tracked bash whose process is gone or ended with no exit code) restores the workspace and tells the MODEL which sha it rebuilt from, but the WorkerAgent host's own log stream never says a line for it — the operator watching the say-stream (not the transcript) still cannot tell a mid-command restore from a mysteriously slow round. The same FactorySandboxEnvOptions.onRestore ear wired for the nonce path in tick dbi could fire from containerLost too; dbi was scoped to the nonce path the tick named, so this is proposed rather than done.
evidence: harness/src/env/factory-sandbox.ts containerLost (~line 910): the restore's sha goes only into the ExecutionError message the model reads; harness/src/host/worker-attempt.ts logs tool calls (beforeTool) but not tool results
